name: Sunway Construction Group Berhad
oneLine: A construction contractor that builds buildings, infrastructure and data centres, mostly in Malaysia, and makes precast concrete parts.
inPlainWords: SunCon is hired by developers, companies and governments to construct things: buildings, civil engineering and infrastructure works, foundations, and mechanical, electrical and plumbing works.
It has delivered more than 156 megawatts of data centre capacity, and it also has a sustainable energy business.
It does most of the specialised work in-house instead of relying on outside vendors, which it says gives it more control over cost, schedule and quality.

flow.label: Clients award projects
flow.detail: Work won but not yet built (the order book) stood at RM5.7 billion at the end of 2025.

flow.label: SunCon builds
flow.detail: Its own teams handle design, foundations, building works and mechanical and electrical works.

flow.label: Paid as work progresses
flow.detail: Revenue is recognised as each project advances. 2025 revenue was RM5.3 billion.

flow.label: Precast factory
flow.detail: Also makes and sells precast concrete components, about 4% of revenue.

moneyNote: For every RM100 of revenue in 2025, about RM8.40 was operating profit (calculated from the segment note). Construction is a thin-margin business, so profit depends on winning enough work and controlling costs.
